title: "Entitled" Woman Gets Caught Shoplifting in 4K Then Tries To Deny It
description:
#news #police #arrest

On February 27th, 2022. Officers were called to a mall regarding a woman who stole expensive cologne from Saks. When officers caught up to her she tried playing dumb and denied any allegations.  

For business inquiries or issues regarding an incident contact:
